Card Q&A.a: It ends as soon as your opponent no longer has any Digimon with no digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: During my turn, all of my opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards are deleted. What happens to this card's inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, Digimon in breeding areas aren't checked by this effect.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate if my opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in their breeding area?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
